title: Arepa de Huevo
description: Arepa de Huevo is a dish from Colombia featuring arepa flour, chicken egg. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Mix the corn flour with the measured water and salt until a soft cohesive, non-sticky masa forms. Rest covered for about 10 minutes; this gluten-free dough does not become elastic like wheat dough.
Shape, press or roll the prepared dough or mixture into portions appropriate to this dish.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 10 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Hollow or prepare the vegetables, then fill with the prepared mixture without packing too tightly.
Fry shaped portions in small batches in oil heated to about 170–175°C for about 10 minutes, until golden; drain on a rack.
